correctness.rationale: On each p-power chain G+L=uvᵀ+vuᵀ and T=G^(-1)L acts as -1 on the codimension-two kernel and by [[0,p^a],[1,0]] on span{e_0,e_a}; eigenvalues -1 repeated a-1 and ±p^(a/2). For complete divisor sets, gcd and lcm products give exact Kronecker matrices, so the full tensor eigenbasis yields factors and multiplicities c_S. The zeta-matrix/totient factorization G=Z diag φ Zᵀ proves positive definiteness and determinant normalization. Inertia follows by congruence, including r=0 and vanishing multiplicities. Independent direct symbolic determinants agree for n=1,4,6,8,12,18,36,60.
